title: Pakistan hosts U.S.-Iran peace talks after weeks of frantic diplomacy
summary: Pakistan's capital, Islamabad, is set to host peace talks today with leaders from Iran and the US, including Vice President J.D. Vance.
contentText:
A senior White House official said that an American delegation, led by Vice President JD Vance, was meeting with senior Iranian negotiators in Islamabad to discuss an end to the six-week long war.

(Image credit: Anjum Naveed)
